title: Lift community — team test
notice: Use made-up examples only. This test does not receive real questions, publish posts, or contact services. Do not enter names, phone numbers, addresses, documents or private information.
task1: Choose Myanmar. Use a daily-life question or write a made-up question in your own words.
task2: Review your draft. Check that you can edit it without losing your words.
task3: Send the made-up question privately. Leave optional AI review unchecked.
task4: Keep the test receipt. Go Home, return to Community and switch languages. Check that the receipt stays the same.
task5: Check status. Open withdrawal, check status without confirming, then confirm withdrawal. These are different actions.
task6: Read the example community card. It is a demonstration, not reviewed real-world information.
exampleTitle: Example only — ask about a housing deposit
exampleBody: Ask what the deposit covers, when it can be refunded, and whether the conditions can be provided in writing. This is a conversation example, not verified housing or legal advice.
exampleLabel: Test example — not published or verified
feedback: Help us improve daily life support
needs: What daily problem or information should Lift help with next?
confusing: Which words, buttons or steps were difficult?
ownQuestion: Add your own question or suggestion
feedbackPrivacy: Feedback stays in this open page. Nothing is uploaded. Download a copy only if you want to give it to your team. Leave out private details.
resetNote: Restarting removes this test’s drafts, receipt and feedback from the open page. Downloaded copies remain outside this page.
ready: The test is ready. No account is needed.
